summary: Tested 3 new features: contact form with Resend integration, social links (GitHub/Instagram), and Z logo in Navbar/Footer. UI renders correctly across all components. Critical backend failure: /api/contact returns 500 due to Resend domain not verified.

critical.issue: Returns 500 - Resend API key is in test mode; can only send to mskiranrao@gmail.com. Domain zasdevlabs.tech not verified in Resend. Error: 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address (mskiranrao@gmail.com).'

integration_issues.issue: Form correctly shows error state when backend returns 500, but success state never triggers because /api/contact always fails in current Resend test configuration

action_items: CRITICAL: Verify zasdevlabs.tech domain in Resend dashboard (resend.com/domains) and update SENDER_EMAIL in backend/.env to use that domain (e.g. noreply@zasdevlabs.tech). Until then the contact form will always fail.
Alternative quick fix: Change OWNER_EMAIL in server.py from skr@zasdevlabs.tech to mskiranrao@gmail.com (the verified address) until domain verification is complete.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 21: resend.api_key set correctly from env. But OWNER_EMAIL is hardcoded as skr@zasdevlabs.tech while Resend test key can only send to mskiranrao@gmail.com — domain verification required.
The error is surfaced cleanly to the user in the UI via the contact-error-message div, so error handling is working correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all UI elements present, form success state untestable due to backend failure)

context_for_next_testing_agent: UI fully renders: Navbar has Z logo + ZasDevLabs brand + GitHub/Instagram icons. Contact section has 2-column layout with email/website cards, GitHub/Instagram 'Soon' buttons, and Send a Message form. Footer has Z logo, social icons, quick links, email/website. The only broken feature is /api/contact returning 500 due to Resend domain not verified. Once domain is verified or OWNER_EMAIL is changed to the verified address, retest contact form submission and success state.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: Resend RESEND_API_KEY=re_gCNhJoNa... is a test key associated with mskiranrao@gmail.com. Resend test accounts restrict sending to only the account owner's verified email. The portfolio sends to OWNER_EMAIL=skr@zasdevlabs.tech which is on an unverified domain. Fix: Go to resend.com/domains → add zasdevlabs.tech → verify DNS records → change SENDER_EMAIL in backend/.env to noreply@zasdevlabs.tech (or any email @zasdevlabs.tech).
